selection: Accept original forced-cohort survival conditioning; no selection on tree size, censoring, score or cap. Retain capped outputs. Rejection-attempt counts and RNG innovations are excluded from the oracle experiment.
nuisance_settings: Use generator/config.json values from ../q012-prototype/config.json, changing ONLY rho=eta/sigma and each declared ensemble lambda0. sigma remains the pre-selection marginal SD 0.5; survival-selected cohort marginals need not have that SD.
stopping: For each ensemble only a simultaneous upper bound below 0.8 on optimal complete-data power at population size 0.05 rules out target recorded-data power for that generator experiment. A lower bound above 0.8 justifies a fresh frozen recorded-data test. Otherwise inconclusive. No sampler restart follows from oracle success.
